title: Customer erased
description: A customer's personal data was erased in crm, and its `externalRef` was released so the same reference can later start a new customer. The event carries the opaque `customerId` only, so a Tenant can react without crm keeping or sending the person's data. The event's `aggregate` is `customer/<customerId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

customerId.description: crm's own opaque id for the customer that was erased.
